textbookText: 4. Ammonia and ammonium nitrate are commonly used agricultural fertilizers. a. Write the molecular formula of these compounds b. Calculate the percentage composition of nitrogen in each compound c. Which one do you think is the best fertilizer, why?
5. Fill the given table with correct molecular formula.
